metadata.name: Double Holy Cards for Tainted Lost
metadata.description:
[h1]Double Holy Cards for Tainted Lost[/h1] Tainted Lost dies to a single hit, and the Holy Card is the one thing that buys a second chance. In vanilla, every card that spawns has a [b]10%[/b] chance to turn into a Holy Card. This mod raises it to [b]20%[/b]: noticeable over a run, while the character keeps its edge.
[h2]What changes[/h2] [list] [*]Random cards from room rewards, chests and other drops [*]Cards in shops (they stay paid) [*]Cards rolled by items such as Deck of Cards or Booster Pack [/list]
[h2]What stays the same[/h2] [list] [*]Cards you drop from your inventory come back as they were [*]Scripted cards, such as The Fool on Depths II [*]Runes, soul stones and objects like Dice Shard keep vanilla's 10% [*]Every other character: the mod only acts when a Tainted Lost is in the game, co-op included [*]No unlock needed, same as vanilla [/list]
[h2]Tested[/h2] Measured in game: 39 Holy Cards out of 203 random card spawns (19.2%), in line with the expected ~19% once runes and objects are counted in.
[h2]Compatibility[/h2] [list] [*]Repentance+, no REPENTOGON needed [*]Do not combine with More Holy Cards for Tainted Lost or other mods that replace random cards. Only one of them takes effect. [/list]
[url=https://github.com/andret2344/tlost-double-hc]Source code on GitHub[/url]
